subject.title: fix(workspace): prevent false Missing labels on existing files and fix panel layout overlap

question: Should `sessions.files.list` expose existence, size, and mtime for transcript-mentioned paths outside the fs-safe workspace boundary, or should external entries be filtered or shown with boundary-preserving neutral semantics?
rationale: The PR changes a read-scoped Gateway boundary, and the safe product behavior for external transcript paths is a maintainer/security decision rather than a mechanical CSS or bugfix choice.

options.title: Preserve Fs-Safe Boundary
options.body: Reject raw filesystem metadata outside the workspace and solve the Missing badge with filtering, neutral external labels, or in-bound directory handling plus regression tests.

options.title: Split Layout First
options.body: Land or keep only a refreshed layout fix while resolving external-path and directory semantics in the linked issue or a narrower backend PR.

options.title: Accept External Metadata
options.body: Allow external path metadata deliberately, but require explicit security acceptance, protocol/UI coverage, and real upgrade proof before merge.

recommendation.title: Preserve Fs-Safe Boundary
recommendation.body: Reject raw filesystem metadata outside the workspace and solve the Missing badge with filtering, neutral external labels, or in-bound directory handling plus regression tests.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent workspace file-preview and read-only browsing commits touched the same gateway/UI boundary and explicitly preserved containment behavior.
